sentences.text: Education is the door to freedom.
sentences.meaning: 教育是通向自由之门。（主系表结构。）
挑战使生活变得有趣。（make + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补。）
困难让生活有价值。（make + 宾语 + 介词短语作宾补。）

sentences.text: Nothing in the world can take the place of persistence.
sentences.meaning: 世界上没有任何东西可以取代坚持。（否定词作主语；take the place of 固定搭配。）

sentences.text: It’s impossible to defeat a person who never gives up!
sentences.meaning: 打败一个永不放弃的人是不可能的。（动词不定式作主语，it 为形式主语；who 引导定语从句。）

sentences.text: The most important thing in life is to have a great aim and the determination to attain it.
sentences.meaning: 生活中最重要的事情就是有一个远大的目标，并有决心实现它。（动词不定式作表语和定语。）

sentences.text: If you can dream it, you can do it.
sentences.meaning: 只要你想得到，你就做得到。（if 引导条件状语从句。）
行动比语言更具有说服力。（副词比较级。）

sentences.text: Deeds are more powerful than words.
sentences.meaning: 行为比言语更强大。（形容词比较级。）

sentences.text: Mistakes show us what we still need to learn.
sentences.meaning: 从错误中我们知道该学什么。（what 引导宾语从句作直接宾语；从句中动词不定式作宾语。）

sentences.text: Difficult times show us who our true friends are.
sentences.meaning: 艰难岁月让我们知道谁是真正的朋友。/患难见真情。（who 引导宾语从句作直接宾语。）

sentences.text: It doesn’t cost anything to be nice.
sentences.meaning: 做好人是不费吹灰之力的。（动词不定式作主语，it 作形式主语。）

sentences.text: Believe in what you can become.
sentences.meaning: 相信自己的潜力。（what 引导名词性从句作介词宾语。）

sentences.text: Think and your mind will stay fresh.
sentences.meaning: 思考能使大脑保持清醒。（祈使句 + and + 主句；祈使句含条件句含义。）

sentences.text: You win because you think you can.
sentences.meaning: 你成功是因为你认为你能成功。（because 引导原因状语从句。）

sentences.text: By helping others, you will feel good about yourself.
sentences.meaning: 帮助别人，其乐无穷。（介词 by 表示手段、途径；动名词作介词宾语。）

sentences.text: Lost time is never found again.
sentences.meaning: 时间一去不复返。（过去分词作定语；一般现在时被动语态。）

sentences.text: Rome wasn’t built in a day.
sentences.meaning: 罗马不是一天建成的。（一般过去时被动语态。）

sentences.text: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
sentences.meaning: 永远不要把今天做的事拖延到明天。（否定形式祈使句；what 引导宾语从句作 put off 的宾语。）

sentences.text: Remember to smile when you wake up.
sentences.meaning: 记得在醒来的时候微笑。（动词不定式作宾语；when 引导时间状语从句。）

sentences.text: Oversleeping will never make your dreams come true.
sentences.meaning: 睡懒觉永远不能让你梦想成真。（动名词作主语；不带 to 的动词不定式作宾补。）

sentences.text: Praise twice as much as you criticize.
sentences.meaning: 多表扬，少批评。（比较级倍数表示法。）

sentences.text: The way to be happy is to make others happy.
sentences.meaning: 快乐的方式就是先让别人快乐。（动词不定式作定语和表语；形容词作 make 的宾补。）

sentences.text: Life is too short to spend time worrying.
sentences.meaning: 生命太短暂了，不要花在焦虑上。（too…to… 表示“太……以至于不能……”；spend time doing 结构。）
使我们痛苦的东西在真正锻炼我们。（what 引导主语从句。）

sentences.text: What doesn’t kill us makes us stronger.
sentences.meaning: 没有要我们命的事情让我们更强大。（what 引导主语从句。）

sentences.text: What hurts us the most teaches us the best.
sentences.meaning: 伤害我们最深的对我们教育最深。（what 引导主语从句；副词最高级。）

sentences.text: The dictionary is the only place where success comes before work.
sentences.meaning: 只有在字典中，成功才会出现在工作之前。（where 引导定语从句。）

sentences.text: To be a great leader, you must have great hopes!
sentences.meaning: 要想成为伟大的领导者，就必须有伟大的抱负。（动词不定式作目的状语。）

sentences.text: He who is ashamed of asking is ashamed of learning.
sentences.meaning: 耻于问者耻于学。（who 引导定语从句；动名词作介词宾语。）

sentences.text: He who fails to plan, plans to fail.
sentences.meaning: 不计划的人是注定要失败的。（who 引导定语从句修饰主语；动词不定式作动词宾语。）

sentences.text: He who makes no mistakes makes nothing.
sentences.meaning: 不犯错误的人将一事无成。（who 引导定语从句修饰主语；双重否定。）

sentences.text: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
sentences.meaning: 想像力比知识更重要。（形容词比较级。）

sentences.text: The hotter the fire, the harder the steel.
sentences.meaning: 火烧得越旺，钢铁就越坚硬。（the + 比较级，the + 比较级。）

sentences.text: Do not let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
sentences.meaning: 决不要让你不能做的事妨碍你能做的事。（what 引导宾语从句作动词宾语；不带 to 的动词不定式作 let 的宾补。）

sentences.text: It’s how you deal with failure that determines how you achieve success.
sentences.meaning: 你如何对待失败注定了你如何取得成功。（强调结构 It is…that…；前一个 how 引导主语从句，后一个 how 引导宾语从句。）

sentences.text: Help others achieve their dreams and you will achieve yours.
sentences.meaning: 帮助他人实现他们的梦想，而你也将因此实现你自己的梦想。（不带 to 的动词不定式作 help 的宾补；祈使句 + and + 主句。）

sentences.text: The achievement of your goal is assured the moment you commit yourself to it.
sentences.meaning: 一旦你全心投入，你目标的实现就得到了保证。（一般现在时被动语态；the moment 引导时间状语从句。）

sentences.text: You become a winner the moment you believe you can win.
sentences.meaning: 当你相信自己能赢的时候，你就成为了胜利者。（the moment 引导时间状语从句；从句中套宾语从句。）

sentences.text: Time and energy spent worrying are wasted.
sentences.meaning: 担忧烦恼，浪费时间，也是浪费精力。（过去分词作定语；一般现在时被动语态。）

sentences.text: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
sentences.meaning: 预测未来的最佳方案就是创造未来。（动词不定式作定语和表语。）

sentences.text: Your brain needs exercise to stay fit, just like your body.
sentences.meaning: 大脑需要锻炼才能保持健康，就像你的身体一样。（动词不定式作目的状语。）

sentences.text: Our greatest weakness lies in giving up; the most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
sentences.meaning: 我们最大的弱点就在于放弃。成功最有把握的方法就是尽力再试一次。（动名词作介词宾语；动词不定式作定语和表语。）

sentences.text: Putting off an easy thing makes it hard. Putting off a hard thing makes it impossible.
sentences.meaning: 简单的事情因为拖延而变得困难；困难的事情因为拖延而变得不可能完成。（动名词作主语；make + 宾语 + 形容词作补语。）

sentences.text: The good luck many great men ever had was being born with the ability to overcome bad luck.
sentences.meaning: 对于许多伟大的人来说，他们唯一的幸运之处就是他们具有征服厄运的天赋。（省略关系代词的定语从句；过去进行时被动语态；动词不定式作定语。）

sentences.text: The greatest discovery of our generation is that a human being can alter his life by altering his attitudes.
sentences.meaning: 我们这一代最大的发现就是：人类可以通过改变态度来改变自己的生活。（that 引导表语从句；动名词作介词宾语。）

sentences.text: It is not what happens to you; it is what you do with what happens to you.
sentences.meaning: 重要的不是在你身上发生了什么，而是应变时你所做的事情。（what 引导表语从句；最后一个 what 引导宾语从句作介词宾语。）

sentences.text: It is not what other people think of you, it is what you think of yourself that counts.
sentences.meaning: 重要的不是别人如何看待你，而是你如何看待你自己。（强调句型 It is…that…；强调 what 引导的主语从句。）

sentences.text: As long as you are dreaming, believing, and doing, you can go anywhere and achieve anything.
sentences.meaning: 只要你有梦想、有信念、有行动，你就可以无往不利，无所不胜。（as long as 引导条件状语从句。）

sentences.text: Whatever you do, do it whole-heartedly.
sentences.meaning: 无论你做什么，都要全心全意地做。（whatever 引导让步状语从句；合成副词 whole-heartedly。）

sentences.text: Success is how high you bounce when you hit bottom.
sentences.meaning: 成功是坠落到底反弹的高度。（how 引导表语从句；从句中 when 引导时间状语从句。）

sentences.text: Success is measured not by how much money you have made, but by how many people you have helped.
sentences.meaning: 衡量成功的标准不是看你赚了多少钱，而是看你帮了多少人。（一般现在时被动语态；how 引导宾语从句作介词宾语；but 连接两个宾语从句表示转折。）

sentences.text: Great works are performed not by strength, but by perseverance.
sentences.meaning: 完成伟大的事业不在于体力，而在于坚忍不拔的毅力。（一般现在时被动语态；but 连接两个介词短语表示转折。）

sentences.text: Man is not judged by his words, but by his deeds.
sentences.meaning: 评判一个人不是看他的言语，而是看他的行动。（一般现在时被动语态；but 连接两个介词短语表示转折。）

sentences.text: No one can humiliate or disturb us unless we let him.
sentences.meaning: 没有任何人能侮辱我们、困扰我们，除非我们自己允许。（unless 引导条件状语从句；省略句 let him 后省略 humiliate or disturb us。）

sentences.text: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
sentences.meaning: 没有你的同意，没有人能让你自卑。（主谓宾补结构。）

sentences.text: To reach your goals, work hard, participate, practice, and do the best you can.
sentences.meaning: 要达成你的目标，你就必须苦干、参与、操练以及尽你所能做到最好。（动词不定式作目的状语；定语从句修饰 the best。）

sentences.text: Genius is the ability to put into effect what is in your mind.
sentences.meaning: 天才就是将心中所想付诸实行的能力。（动词不定式作定语；what 引导宾语从句。）

sentences.text: Life doesn’t require that we be the best, only that we try our best.
sentences.meaning: 生活并不是要求我们是最好的，只要求我们做到最好。（that 引导宾语从句；require 后宾语从句中动词用虚拟语气 should + 动词原形。）

sentences.text: Success is not measured by the position you reach in life; it’s measured by the obstacles you overcome.
sentences.meaning: 成功不是用你一生取得的地位来衡量的，而是看你克服了多少障碍。（一般现在时被动语态；定语从句修饰句中的介词宾语。）

sentences.text: It is in your moments of decision that your destiny is shaped.
sentences.meaning: 人生就注定于你做决定的那一刻。（强调句型 It is…that…；一般现在时被动语态。）

sentences.text: The surest way not to fail is to determine to succeed.
sentences.meaning: 不致失败的最可靠的方法是决心成功。（动词不定式作定语、表语和宾语。）

sentences.text: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
sentences.meaning: 如果我们对任何事情都没有勇气尝试，人生还有什么意义？（虚拟语气条件句；动词不定式作定语。）

sentences.text: The world belongs to the energetic.
sentences.meaning: 世界属于充满活力的人。（the + 形容词表示一类人。）

sentences.text: Early to bed and early to rise keeps a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
sentences.meaning: 早睡早起让人健康、富足和智慧。（两个动词不定式并列作主语；形容词作 keep 的宾补。）

sentences.text: The human will can be strengthened like a muscle.
sentences.meaning: 人类的意志可以像肌肉一样被增强。（情态动词的被动语态；like 作介词引导介词短语。）

sentences.text: Only a fool criticizes what he does not understand.
sentences.meaning: 只有傻瓜才会批评他不懂的事。（only 修饰主语；what 引导宾语从句。）

sentences.text: Success grows out of the struggle to overcome difficulties.
sentences.meaning: 成功来自于克服困难的斗争。（动词不定式作定语。）

sentences.text: Each day, take at least one step toward your goal. The step doesn’t have to be big; moving forward even a small amount is progress.
sentences.meaning: 每天至少向你的目标迈进一步。这一步不一定要很大，哪怕是向前一点，都是进步。（副词短语 at least 修饰动词宾语；动名词短语作主语。）

sentences.text: Remind yourself to laugh and smile. You can always make room for happiness.
sentences.meaning: 提醒自己大笑、微笑。你总可以找到欢乐。（动词不定式作宾补；remind sb to do 结构；make room for 固定搭配。）

sentences.text: Everyone is important. Anyone can change the world. No one should underestimate his power.
sentences.meaning: 人人都是重要的。任何人都可以改变世界。没有人会低估他自己的力量！（不定代词 everyone 和 anyone 的用法。）

sentences.text: You don’t need an invitation to help others. Help before you are asked.
sentences.meaning: 帮助别人是不需要邀请的。在别人开口之前就伸出援助之手吧！（动词不定式作定语；before 引导时间状语从句；一般现在时被动语态。）

sentences.text: Push yourself to do more than others believe you can do. Then, encourage others to push themselves just as hard.
sentences.meaning: 逼自己做超越别人期望的事。然后，帮助别人也一样努力去逼迫自己前进。（动词不定式作宾语；than 引导比较状语从句。）

sentences.text: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
sentences.meaning: 未来属于那些相信自己梦想的人。（who 引导定语从句；belong to 属于。）

sentences.text: Harsh advice is the most instructive.
sentences.meaning: 忠言逆耳利于行。（形容词最高级。）

sentences.text: Don’t wait for the world to change. Change it yourself.
sentences.meaning: 不要等世界改变，去改变世界吧！（带逻辑主语的动词不定式作动词宾语。）

sentences.text: The only true failure is the failure to try.
sentences.meaning: 唯一真正的失败是没有去尝试。（动词不定式作定语。）

sentences.text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
sentences.meaning: 无热情无以成伟业。（双重否定；不定代词加形容词需后置；一般过去时被动语态。）

sentences.text: There is no challenge more challenging than improving yourself.
sentences.meaning: 没什么挑战比提高自我更有挑战性。（现在分词短语作定语；动名词作介词 than 的宾语。）

sentences.text: Confidence is contagious. So is lack of confidence.
sentences.meaning: 自信是具有感染力的。不自信也一样。（倒装句；so 引起的部分倒装。）
自信就是成功的一半。（主系表结构。）

sentences.text: Attitude is just as important as ability.
sentences.meaning: 态度和能力一样重要。（同级比较。）

sentences.text: You’re unique with special gifts; use them.
sentences.meaning: 你是独一无二的，你有独特的才能。发挥它们吧！（分号连接两个等立的分句。）

sentences.text: We’re all capable if we have faith and passion.
sentences.meaning: 只要我们有信仰、有激情，我们就都是有能力的。（if 引导条件状语从句。）

sentences.text: Diligence is the mother of good luck.
sentences.meaning: 勤奋是好运之母。（暗喻的运用。）

sentences.text: If you’re doing your best, you will not have to worry about failure.
sentences.meaning: 如果你尽力而为，你就不必担忧失败。（条件状语从句。）

sentences.text: Those who turn back never reach the summit.
sentences.meaning: 中途折返的人永远都到达不了顶峰。（who 引导定语从句修饰主语。）
成功者永不停止尝试。（动名词作宾语。）

sentences.text: The first and best victory is to conquer yourself.
sentences.meaning: 最重要的胜利是战胜自己。（动词不定式作表语。）

sentences.text: Take chances, make mistakes. That’s how you grow.
sentences.meaning: 去冒险，去犯错误！你就是这样成长起来的！（how 引导表语从句。）

sentences.text: True strength flows from a healthy body and mind working in harmony.
sentences.meaning: 真正的力量来自于健康身体和健康大脑的合作无间。（现在分词作定语。）

sentences.text: Failure is the sauce that gives success its flavor.
sentences.meaning: 失败是成功的调味品。（that 引导定语从句；暗喻的运用。）

sentences.text: Failure teaches you more than success.
sentences.meaning: 失败的价值大于成功。/从失败中，我们学到更多。（副词比较级。）

sentences.text: Make full use of whatever happens to you. There is something to learn from every experience.
sentences.meaning: 充分利用发生在你身上的任何事情。任何的经历都有值得学习的地方。（whatever 引导宾语从句作介词宾语；动词不定式作定语；make full use of 固定搭配。）

sentences.text: Goodness is the only investment that never fails.
sentences.meaning: 善良是唯一不会失败的投资。（定语从句；先行词中有 only，关系代词只能用 that。）

sentences.text: Life is a struggle that must be accepted. Accepting the struggle happily or miserably is up to us to decide.
sentences.meaning: 生活是你必须接受的斗争。快乐地接受还是悲惨地接受就要由你决定了。（定语从句；动名词短语作主语。）

sentences.text: If you cannot be an excellent loser, you’ll never succeed.
sentences.meaning: 如果你不能成为一个优秀的失败者，你就永远不能成功！（条件状语从句。）

sentences.text: No matter how hard you try or how much time you spend worrying, some things just cannot be changed. Accept them and move on!
sentences.meaning: 不管你多么努力地尝试，不管你花多少时间担忧，总有些事是无法改变的。接受它们，继续前行吧！（让步状语从句，由 no matter how 引导。）

sentences.text: Continuous efforts—not strength or intelligence—is the key to unlocking our potential.
sentences.meaning: 释放潜能的关键不是力量，也不是智慧，而是不断的努力。（动名词作介词宾语。）

供应某人某物=动介搭配
配备某人某物=动介搭配
保护某人免受=动介搭配
警告某人某事=动介搭配
通知某人某事=动介搭配
因…向某人道歉=动介搭配
完全不能接受=副形搭配
久坐生活方式=健康话题
性别薪酬差距=工作话题
工作生活平衡=工作话题
对...漠不关心=动词介词搭配
抱怨某事=动词介词搭配
向某人抱怨=动词介词搭配
同意某人=动词介词搭配
